channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nic Claxton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nic Claxton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson
item.description:
coach Tiago Splitter said of Hield’s role.

“You’re open, shoot it. When you surround your team with gravity like those guys (Hield and Powell), it opens it up for Caleb (Wilson), Matas (Buzelis) to get to the paint, for Nic (Claxton), for Tre (Jones), Josh (Giddey) – they’re all going to play in the paint.”

Tiago Splitter on Buddy Hield, Tre Jones, Nic Claxton, Josh Giddey, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Cam Thomas on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Lowe responded to Thomas' clapback on the latest episode of his podcast.

“If Cam Thomas had listened to the subsequent 12 minutes — I don't think he did, but I don't know — he would have heard me deep dive into his game and talk about career-high in assists, certain kind of passes he's gotten meaningfully better at. Nic Claxton lobs, little dump-offs, and stuff like that,”

Cam Thomas on Nic Claxton, Jul 22, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on talking w/ Nic Claxton about flagrant suspensions:

“We've had those conversations, private conversations. He holds himself accountable to a really high standard. And we're going to miss him tonight. And that's what's most important.”

Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton, Feb 26, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kirk Goldsberry on Robert Williams, Nic Claxton
item.description:
Kirk Goldsberry:

“Nicolas Claxton and Robert Williams III are the names that keep coming up, and I would guess that one of them will be on the Lakers.”

Kirk Goldsberry on Robert Williams, Nic Claxton, Feb 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on whether Nic Claxton's back injury will require a minutes restriction moving forward:

“We're going to manage it, but the good news was that everything was clean. We're going to need to put in a certain kind of work with him... I don't know how many weeks, but soon enough, he'll be the best version of himself, and that's what we want.”

Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton, Nov 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton's back injury and epidural:

“I know it’s been an issue that’s been lingering a little bit with his lower back...[We're] not super concerned. We want to keep him healthy. His body is the number one thing for us. And now it’s next man up.”

Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton, Nov 15, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on whether he still views Ben Simmons and Nic Claxton as a viable pairing in a featured lineup:

“With the limitations as far as health and minutes, we haven’t been able to, but we could for sure see it. Right now, the team has been competing well. The groups that have been put together have worked, but I’m not saying that this is the only thing we will do. I’m open to trying different groups.”

Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton, Nov 7, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton's potential to start:

“There's a plan for him to start at some point. Right now, it's important that he goes through the back-to-back and he feels good, and then from there, we will readdress the situation.”

Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton, Nov 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton:

“When Nic's ready, mentally & physically capable and ready to perform, then he'll be back on a court... That's the athletes decision,and Nic's in a zone right now where he wants to feel comfortable about returning and playing on a high level.”

Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton, his progress and odds of playing tomorrow vs. the #Celtics:

“Nic has not participated in shootaround, I can say that to you. So if that leads you to any direction to seeing if Nic's gonna be available tomorrow, probably not.”

Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton, Nov 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on his approach with Ben Simmons and Nic Claxton sharing the floor:

“I gotta have the right combination around them. Those other three guys have to be the right three guys. The spacing around them has to be pretty premium and pretty detailed. And then we’ve gotta put Ben and Nic in positions to react with the basketball, without the basketball with what their spacing looks like.”

Jacque Vaughn on Ben Simmons, Nic Claxton, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Doc Rivers on Nic Claxton:

“He's been great. Defensively - we already knew he was going to be a special defender, but he's really improved offensively. His quick decision, his straight line attacks, his first step for a big, he's really improved. He's finishing.”

Doc Rivers on Nic Claxton, Feb 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Asked Jacque Vaughn about Nets miscommunications on screens against Indiana:

“There’s too many possessions where it has been, 'Hey Nic Claxton, go guard (Anfernee) Simons, go guard Haliburton, and then the rest of us are gonna chill over here.' Too many possessions that way.”

Jacque Vaughn on Nic Claxton, Nov 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Steve Nash on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Nash on Nic Claxton:

“Its just an illness, but it's nothing major, nothing that we're really overly concerned with. It's just a little more severe illness than we thought initially. He's gonna miss a little bit of time.”

Steve Nash on Nic Claxton, Oct 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Nic Claxton
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Coach Jordan Ott on Nic Claxton not playing in Vegas:

“I think that was just a discussion, collaborative discussion between him, his people, our people, and they felt the best was don’t play Summer League.”

Jordan Ott on Nic Claxton, Aug 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
